details:
Description

After updating to 1885, the video player in this world is causing my game to drop to 10-20fps every ~5 seconds, when i was supposed to be at stable 150+ fps

I do not believe it's the world's fault, since it started to happen after updating my game. Also, the world has an button to disable the Video Player, which, if disabled, the framerate dropping stops.

Reproduction Steps

Join this world and DO NOT disable the video player, that's all. The video player is enabled by default, so it will hit you once you join. You can disable the video player by pressing "E" and clicking the Video Player button. By the way, for some reason i could not find any friend having the same issues, so, might be AMD related? Also, i'm playing through Unity-6 Public Beta and i do use the parameter "--enable-hw-video-decoding" in my launch settings.

Details

- Category: World

- Frequency: Always
